writeup.title: feat(coupons): allow stacking one percent and one flat coupon
writeup.summary: Orders can now apply up to two coupons concurrently, provided one is a percentage coupon and one is a flat coupon. Percent coupons are applied to the subtotal first, and flat coupons apply to the remainder.
changes: Added kind_already_applied to prevent applying multiple coupons of the same kind to a cart.
Added stack_discounts to apply percent coupons first and flat coupons to the remaining subtotal.
Updated pricing quote calculation to use stacked discounts.
Added and updated coupon stacking tests.

functions.what_it_does: Returns true if the cart already contains a coupon of the specified kind.
Attaches a validated coupon to the user's cart ensuring max coupon limits and distinct kinds are respected.
Computes the price quote for the cart including stacked discounts and shipping.
Applies percent coupons first to the subtotal and then flat coupons to the remaining amount.

writeup.release_note: Orders can use two coupons: one percent and one flat. Percent coupons apply first.
